item.title: Cosmos Music Player v1.2.5
item.description:
Cosmos Music Player 1.2.5 | Cosmos-Music-Player
- Search is now available across songs, favorites, artists, albums, and playlists. - Lyrics have been redesigned with smoother synchronization, tap-to-seek, instrumental breaks, offline caching, and alternate versions. - Added broader support for Opus, Ogg, FLAC, AAC/M4A, DSF, and DFF files. - Improved playback stability, gapless transitions, seeking, Bluetooth, CarPlay, and audio interruption handling. - Added appearance options: System, Light, and Dark. - Added controls for automatic library scan frequency and artist organization. - Added a Create Playlist button when no playlists exist. - Improved artwork loading for iCloud and externally imported music. - Improved Siri, widgets, CarPlay, and Share extension reliability. - Fixed library issues involving moved, renamed, restored, or temporarily unavailable files. - Added and improved translations across all supported languages. - Includes numerous performance improvements and bug fixes.
